tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Inspect this connection’s scope, tools and access policy. With no arguments returns the usual catalog. On the general or economy connection, optionally supply report_countries (1–10 World Bank codes) for a FREE live preview of the optional paid country comparison: population/GDP/inflation by default

tools.name: get_exchange_rates
tools.description: ECB indicative daily currency reference rates against EUR. Not real-time or executable prices; inspect observation_date. Original rates freely available at the cited ECB source.

tools.name: list_exchange_rate_history
tools.description: List available currencies, annual snapshots since 1999 and explicit gaps in ECB daily reference FX history. Some currencies have been discontinued. Units per EUR; original data freely available at ECB.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate_history
tools.description: ECB historical daily reference rates for one currency against EUR. Provide year (1999 onward) or an exact date, not both. Default: current year. Returns one year at most, original decimals, missing values and evidence. No weekend carry-forward, interpolation, current quote for discontinued currencie

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get an unexpired record with provenance and its explicit verification level. Source/schema validation is not independent factual verification.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve the source JSON snapshot and SHA-256 digest for a currently available record. The digest proves snapshot integrity, not factual truth.

tools.name: convert_currency_batch
tools.description: Free pilot: convert dated decimal-string amounts to a target_currency chosen from 30 supported currencies, including EUR (default), USD, JPY, CNY, GBP, CHF, INR and KRW. Use exact-date ECB historical references; derived cross conversions use amount * target units per EUR / source units per EUR witho

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "convert_currency_batch" is 1230 chars, far longer than this server's median (201). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
